_doc: Shot plan: one entry per timeline scene. motion = what is ON SCREEN as the primary visual (clip | film | graphic | parallax | kenburns | still | text). planlint verifies motion against clips.json + media.json (a declared clip whose file is missing is a silent fallback) and measures static holds from the built timeline.

brand.fonts: Oswald, Anton, DM Serif, Special Elite
brand.title: red-band headline + paper kicker

fingerprint.music: D minor → F major, procedural pads, 60 bpm pulse
fingerprint.structure: 10 scenes: context → alarm count → chain → decision → wait → cause → aftermath → personal → obituary

shots.subject: bunker interior
shots.information_role: Establishes time and place: night shift inside a Soviet early-warning bunker.
shots.reason: Cold open where it happened; the title card carries the hook.

shots.subject: KAL 007 airliner and clippings
shots.information_role: Context: Moscow had just shot down an airliner (269 dead), so tension was extreme.
shots.reason: Explains why an attack seemed plausible before the alarm happens.

shots.subject: launch console with red screen
shots.information_role: The alarm: СТАРТ on screen, missiles counted 1→5 on the globe.
shots.reason: Punch-in on the alarm word; the count is the rising action.

shots.subject: chain-of-command dossier
shots.information_role: Stakes: the report would climb to leaders with minutes to decide; the film shows what 'strike back' means.
shots.reason: Visualises the ladder the alarm would climb; the archive film lands on 'strike back'.

shots.subject: Petrov portrait (illustration)
shots.information_role: Introduces the protagonist and his reasoning: five missiles is not how a war starts.
shots.reason: First time we see his face; the quote card carries his logic.

shots.subject: telephone and wall clock
shots.information_role: The decision and the 23-minute wait (clock counts up).
shots.reason: Close on the phone he used to report the false alarm; the clock makes the wait visible.

shots.subject: satellite over sunlit clouds
shots.information_role: The cause: sunlight on high clouds fooled the satellite.
shots.reason: Reveal; the white flash is the sun glint itself.

shots.subject: logbook with stamps
shots.information_role: Aftermath: no medal, reprimand for paperwork, 15 years classified.
shots.reason: The paper trail itself; stamps slam on each fact.

shots.subject: kitchen, Petrov and wife
shots.information_role: Personal cost: his wife never knew; 'Nothing. I did nothing.'
shots.reason: Shift from history to the human; warm grade marks memory.

shots.subject: memorial stone photo, then Earth
shots.information_role: Real-world proof (memorial) and the obituary line: survived by the entire human race.
shots.reason: The only real photograph lands as evidence; Earth widens to the climax.
